title: Geometric exact comparison ladder for two-open etale continuity
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $U,V\subseteq X$ quasi-compact opens [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Assume the stage-continuity property $C(U)$, $C(V)$ and $C(U\cap V)$ of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-stage-continuity]. Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set and let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ be an inverse diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(T,(f_i))$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $i$, let $F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $(D_i)_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with maps $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ for $f:i\to j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(T_{\acute{e}t})$ be identified objectwise with $f_i^{-1}F_i$ by isomorphisms, its arrows being inverse-image composition followed by pullback of $\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone on $G$, with coprojections $\iota_i$. Fix $p\ge0$. Let $H:I\to\operatorname{Ab}$ have specified object isomorphisms $e_i:H_i\cong H^p(D_i,F_i)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and arrows conjugate to $H^p(\varphi_f)\circ D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Let $B$ be a cocone on $H$ with an isomorphism $e:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\cong H^p(T,L_{\mathrm{pt}})$ such that, for every $i$, its leg $b_i$ satisfies $e\circ b_i=H^p(\iota_i)\circ f_i^*\circ e_i$, including the specified identification $G_i\cong f_i^{-1}F_i$. Fix an index $i_0\in I$ and an isomorphism $\epsilon:D_{i_0}\cong (U\cup V)$. Put $g=f_{i_0}$ followed by $\epsilon$ and the inclusion $U\cup V\to X$, and let $W_U=g^{-1}(U)$ and $W_V=g^{-1}(V)$. Put $Q=\varinjlim_I H_i$, with its canonical comparison $m:Q\to B_{\mathrm{pt}}$ induced by the cocone $B$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Put $B_4=H^p(W_U,L|_{W_U})\times H^p(W_V,L|_{W_V})$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and let $r':B_{\mathrm{pt}}\to B_4$ be the pair of canonical restriction maps after $e:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\cong H^p(T,L_{\mathrm{pt}})$. There exist abelian groups $A_1,A_2,A_4,B_1,B_2$ and additive homomorphisms $a:A_1\to A_2$, $b:A_2\to Q$, $r:Q\to A_4$, $a':B_1\to B_2$, $b':B_2\to B_{\mathrm{pt}}$, $v_1:A_1\to B_1$, $v_2:A_2\to B_2$, $v_4:A_4\to B_4$ such that $\operatorname{im}a=\ker b$, $\operatorname{im}b=\ker r$, $\operatorname{im}a'=\ker b'$, $v_1$ is surjective, $v_2$ and $v_4$ are injective, and $v_2a=a'v_1$, $mb=b'v_2$, $v_4r=r'm$. This statement supplies the geometric ladder and its neighboring comparisons; it does not assert the middle comparison is injective or any finite-stage zero witness.

proof.text: Obtain the pointwise exact stage diagram, cofinality isomorphism, commuting comparison squares and certified neighboring maps from the geometric ladder construction. This construction assumes no continuity.

Exactness of the filtered-colimit pairs follows by the elementwise representative argument. A class killed by the colimit map is represented at a stage; equality to zero holds at a later stage, where pointwise exactness supplies a preimage. Conversely represent a preimage class and use stage exactness. Transport middle exactness through eQ and use injectivity of its hom for the other pair. This is implemented by the proved private exact_colimMap and exact_transport_middle lemmas, using Mathlib Concrete.colimit_exists_rep and Concrete.colimit_exists_of_rep_eq.

Case analysis on membership in the three allowed schemes supplies their continuity hypotheses. Apply the certificate bijectivity theorem to the three neighboring comparisons and take its surjective or injective component. Combine those components, the two proved colimit-exactness pairs, bottom exactness and the three supplied squares into the original unchanged existential conclusion.
